strategy: Vivid five-colour midrange - real WUBRG mana, mono-coloured Vivid ETB value
identity: The literal reading of the archetype: a genuine WUBRG manabase built so the best Vivid card in every colour can be cast. Where the two-colour build fakes five colours with hybrid cards, this one pays for them - five untapped rare duals, five common duals, an Eclipsed Realms, an Evolving Wilds and six basics - and is rewarded with the mono-coloured Vivid cards no other build can play: Shimmercreep drains X and gains X, Squawkroaster is an X-power double striker, Kithkeeper makes X two-coloured tokens, Explosive Prodigy is X damage on a body. The colour count itself is carried by cheap two-colour permanents - Figure of Fable is green and white on turn one, Mischievous Sneakling is blue and black on turn two - and capped by Tam, whose '{T}: Target creature you control becomes all colors' sets X to 5 from turn three onward.
